text:
amy_sales: quick heads-up — NordicBank POC wants BYOK + HSM-proxy + strict rotation SLAs. They've listed: HSM 99.99% availability, rotation rollback <=2h, customer-managed KMS in their VPC, dual-custody key approval, 7yr audit retention. Can ops/finance/infosec confirm blockers and a rough SOW estimate?

sam_se: @amy_sales can support most of it. HSM-proxy is doable as a managed proxy VM in the customer's VPC, but expect ~8-15ms added latency for encrypt ops. We need an infra ticket for reserved proxy capacity and NAT routing. Also need a small network diagram from customer.

juan_security: Dual custody + BYOK requires attestation proof and key ceremony docs. We'll need FIPS/HSM model alignment and a pen test scheduled. Also, remote attestation: customer expects attestation every 90 days — that's fine but adds ops overhead.

matt_finance: For SOW ballpark: base Dedicated capacity + HSM-proxy addon + per-key escrow/rotation fee. Quick estimate: $8k/mo reserved + $2k/mo proxy + $150/key/mo for cust-managed keys — rough. Need token throughput and number of keys to firm up.

amy_sales: they provided expected QPS: 1200 encrypt reqs/s peak, mostly 64B payloads. Rotation cadence: daily ephemeral wrapping keys; full-key rotations monthly for master KEKs.

sam_se: given 1200 qps, we should recommend a small HA HSM pool (2 nodes), enable prefix caching to lower encrypt latency, and set batching window <=10ms. Network egress path must allow: 

```
iptables: allow 10.0.0.0/16 -> proxy:443
customer firewall: allow outbound to our control-plane on 52.20.34.10:443
```

juan_security: Also request from legal: SCARF & AIC for BYOK; add clause for rotation rollback SLA and forensics access. Pen-test: schedule within POC week 2.

matt_finance: pricing note — if they commit to 12mo reserved, we can discount proxy fee 25% and waive setup for one-time key ceremony. Need Sales to confirm commitment level.

amy_sales: action items: 1) @sam_se open infra ticket with proxy sizing + latency mitigation plan. 2) @juan_security list attestation docs and pen-test checklist. 3) @matt_finance produce draft SOW numbers and optional 12mo discount. I'll loop in customer for network diagram.

ops_bot: created ticket INF-2941: HSM-proxy sizing for NordicBank POC — assignee sam_se, due 1738473600 :white_check_mark:

sam_se: noted. I'll pull throughput logs from similar POCs and attach config. Ping me if legal needs example SOW language.

juan_security: I'll draft attestation template and sample AIC language by EOD tomorrow.

matt_finance: I'll drop an initial SOW spreadsheet in the sales drive and ping here when ready. :moneybag:

amy_sales: thanks team. Keeping this thread as the single source for blockers. :thumbsup:
